mapper.select:
select m.media_id, m.title, m.original_title, m.media_type, m.poster_local_url, m.release_date, m.region, m.source, count(a.id) as wish_count, max(a.wished_time) as last_wish_time, (select count(*) from km_media_resource r where r.media_id = m.media_id) as resource_count, (select count(*) from km_media_release rl where rl.media_id = m.media_id) as provider_count from km_user_media_action a join km_media m on m.media_id = a.media_id and m.del_flag = '0' where a.wished = '1'
and (m.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or m.original_title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and m.media_type = #{mediaType} group by m.media_id, m.title, m.original_title, m.media_type, m.poster_local_url, m.release_date, m.region, m.source having resource_count = 0 order by wish_count desc, last_wish_time desc

select a.user_id, mb.username, mb.nickname, a.wished_time from km_user_media_action a left join km_member mb on mb.member_id = a.user_id where a.media_id = #{mediaId} and a.wished = '1' order by a.wished_time desc limit 500
